API_surface_audit.native_token: Runtime lookup key; unique reserved marker must survive exactly. Zero/previous-real collisions are not repaired.
API_surface_audit.picture_number: Public header calls it ordinal display number, not input AU/POC. Not used for this mapping; the frozen P1 trace did not capture it, so no invented values or narrow-case one-to-one assertion.
API_surface_audit.h264_extension: Pan-scan/crop/VUI fields; no original AU ID or H264 POC.
API_surface_audit.flags: Frozen original/private returned flags are all0; flags alone do not distinguish them.
API_surface_audit.session_drop_layout_fields: No independent per-original AU identity proof; never used to retag an opaque unknown buffer.
API_surface_audit.firmware_research: Existing private firmware-research picture-metadata/host-PIB contract inspected read-only; no proprietary bodies copied, no new physical PPB ownership claim.

runtime_algorithm: Reserve a fresh nonzero2ms-aligned native marker in a bounded generation without reading the next source PTS or submitting its VCL.
After the actual next original VCL is accepted, bind that marker to this source record (AU ID,PTS/DTS,timebase,parsed POC/GOP/reference information).

Lookup actual returned native owner; private known owners are hidden, unique bound original owners project their saved source PTS. Unknown0,duplicate,stale,unaligned,unbound/colliding owners fail closed.
Native token remains a separate diagnostic value. Whole-image hashes/reference matches validate the independent algorithm, never select its output identity.
RX release is owned by the native probe. The display test copies the actual pixels before release and exports only that owned copy after release; metadata lookup grants no early RX/DMA reuse.

H0_H1.interpretation: Generic collision-free early marker qualifies only the separate host-effective-PTS policy; token0 and previous-real collision remain UNSUPPORTED. The strict native gate still fails for reserved markers.
